headline: The sky learns to answer a spray
lede: WWI DOGFIGHT's Vickers now runs hot: hold the trigger and the barrel reddens, the tracers walk, and long-range receipts dry up — the discipline the autopilot always had is now a rule the player pays for too.

notes.text: Burst discipline shipped (#2310, live): ~13 rounds redden the barrel, ~5.5 s of silence cools it, and past the soft band every round leaves on a deterministic cone ~7 m wide at 250 m — the GUNS tape in the cockpit turns red and the sky says so.

The receipt gate folds in the same deviation it spawns with, so autopilot promises stay bit-exact: its short bursts never leave the cold band (max heat 0.077), both patrol wins, slack and determinism are unchanged — the new rule bites only spray. 83/83 Node checks, 9 mutants dead, 23/23 browser checks.
A manual mutant plus `git checkout` on an uncommitted file is how work evaporates: checkpoint-push before experimenting, always. The #2047 lesson wearing a new hat.

look.text: Hold SPACE for two seconds and watch the GUNS tape redden, then let go
